instruction: A clean studio portrait photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Beside her, the brunette woman in the brown top and leggings (R2) stands on the right, leaning her head affectionately on the blonde woman's shoulder and holding her arm. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting with soft shadows and a warm pastel palette.
